notes.AUS: 聯邦與各州都合法，適用的病症各州不同
notes.AUT: 只准 dronabinol、Sativex、nabilone 這類大麻藥品
notes.BRA: 只限末期病人或其他治療都無效的病人
notes.CZE: 憑處方合法；不用處方可以買 THC 1% 以下的產品
notes.FRA: 3,000 名病人參加的兩年試辦計畫
notes.GEO: 法律上可以，但實際上沒有供應醫療大麻的制度
notes.IND: 只准 CBD 油（THC 0.3% 以下）
notes.IRL: 2019 年 6 月起的 5 年試辦計畫
notes.PRK: 憑處方可以，但不確定有沒有供應的制度
notes.KOR: 只准 Epidiolex、Marinol、Sativex（食品醫藥品安全處的政策）
notes.MEX: 法律上可以，但沒有供應醫療大麻的制度
notes.PHL: 原則違法，可以向食品藥物管理局申請特別許可
notes.ROU: 只准 THC 0.2% 以下的大麻藥品
notes.ZAF: 法律上可以，但沒有供應醫療大麻的制度
notes.LKA: 依殖民時期法律的修正與阿育吠陀法（傳統醫學）
notes.SWE: 病人取得許可才可以，條件有限
notes.TUR: 只准 THC 0.3% 以下的大麻藥品（2025 年起）
notes.GBR: 只有專科醫師可以開大麻藥品
notes.USA: 依州而定：41 州、4 個屬地與華盛頓特區合法，聯邦列第三級管制
notes.TWN: 大麻是第二級毒品（毒品危害防制條例）；條目寫 Illegal，但食藥署 2024 年 1 月核准大麻二酚口服液 Epidyolex（衛部罕藥輸字第000094號），用於 Dravet 症候群與結節性硬化症的癲癇輔助治療，所以歸「只准特定藥品」

notesEn.AUS: Legal federally and in all states; qualifying conditions vary by state
notesEn.AUT: Only cannabis medicines such as dronabinol, Sativex and nabilone
notesEn.BRA: Only for terminally ill patients or those who have exhausted other treatments
notesEn.CZE: Legal with a prescription; products up to 1% THC sold without one
notesEn.FRA: A two-year trial programme with 3,000 patients
notesEn.GEO: Technically legal, but there is no system for dispensing it
notesEn.IRL: A five-year pilot programme from June 2019
notesEn.PRK: Legal on prescription, but no confirmed system for dispensing it
notesEn.KOR: Only Epidiolex, Marinol and Sativex (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety policy)
notesEn.MEX: Legal, but there is no system for dispensing it
notesEn.PHL: Illegal, but a special permit may be granted
notesEn.ZAF: Legal, but there is no system for dispensing medical cannabis
notesEn.LKA: Under amendments to colonial law and the Ayurveda Act (traditional medicine)
notesEn.SWE: Only for patients who obtain a licence, under limited circumstances
notesEn.GBR: Cannabis medicines may be prescribed only by a specialist
notesEn.USA: Varies by state: legal in 41 states, 4 territories and DC; Schedule III federally
notesEn.TWN: Cannabis is a Schedule 2 narcotic; Wikipedia says illegal, but in January 2024 the Taiwan FDA licensed the cannabidiol oral solution Epidyolex (licence 000094) as add-on treatment for seizures in Dravet syndrome and tuberous sclerosis complex, so it is classed as specific medicines only
